body.message:
As per your request, please find below the monthly rate for the Canal Front Skyline View – 2-Bedroom Apartment:

Stay Period: 4 October to 3 November (30 nights)
Monthly Rate: AED 20,000
Security Deposit: AED 2,000

*
Please note that the rate currently displayed on our website is applicable only for the September period. Rates may vary from month to month depending on availability and demand. The applicable rate for your requested period is mentioned above.
*

The booking will be calculated on a 30-night monthly basis.

*For long-stay bookings*, the first month’s rent, last month’s rent, and security deposit are required in advance to confirm and secure the reservation. Once the payment is received, we can reserve the apartment and secure the agreed rates for the confirmed booking period.

Thank you, and please let us know if you would like to proceed. We will be happy to assist you further.
